abstract: How does higher productivity affect inflation? Productivity shifts both supply and demand (through real incomes), and its effect on inflation depends on their relative magnitude and timing, and on how monetary policy responds. We distinguish between a one-off level shock that temporarily increases productivity above trend and a persistent increase in productivity growth. A one-off shock lowers marginal costs and lifts potential output, generating downward pressure on the price level. However, this is a level effect and once prices adjust, inflation returns to target. In contrast, higher productivity growth raises expected permanent income, which stimulates investment and consumption, pushing up on the natural real rate. Absent a tightening of monetary policy, this can generate inflationary pressures. Anticipation effects are central: if demand rises ahead of realised productivity gains, inflation can rise even as productive capacity expands. In an open economy, the impact on inflation also depends on whether productivity gains occur in the tradable or the non-tradable sector. In summary, the inflationary consequences of higher productivity are a priori ambiguous and depend on the balance and timing of demand and supply responses, the composition of consumption across tradables and non-tradables, and importantly, the monetary policy response.
abstract_zh: 更高的生产率如何影响通货膨胀？生产率同时影响供给与需求（通过实际收入），其对通胀的影响取决于两者的相对规模与时机，以及货币政策如何应对。我们区分一次性水平冲击（使生产率暂时高于趋势）与生产率增长的持续性提升。一次性冲击降低边际成本并提升潜在产出，对价格水平产生下行压力。然而，这是一种水平效应，一旦价格调整完毕，通胀将回归目标水平。相比之下，生产率增长加快会提高预期永久收入，从而刺激投资与消费，推高自然实际利率。若缺乏货币政策的收紧，这可能引发通胀压力。预期效应至关重要：若需求在生产率实际提升之前先行上升，即使生产能力扩张，通胀也可能上升。在开放经济中，通胀影响还取决于生产率提升发生在可贸易部门还是不可贸易部门。总之，更高生产率对通胀的影响在理论上具有不确定性，取决于需求与供给反应的平衡与时机、可贸易品与不可贸易品消费的构成，以及尤为重要的货币政策应对。
title: Productivity and Inflation Dynamics
title_zh: DP21876 生产率与通货膨胀动态

abstract: We introduce the notion of marginal cumulative multiplier — the effect of either government spending or taxation on output holding the other fiscal instrument constant - and apply it to a well known panel of consolidation episodes in 16 countries in the period 1978-2020. In our benchmark specification we estimate a marginal spending multiplier at two years of 1.5 and a marginal tax multiplier close to 0. We also estimate similar multipliers by applying the policy counterfactual method of McKay and Wolf (2023). In an extensive robustness analysis we never find spending multipliers below 1.3 or tax multipliers higher than -1. These findings are seemingly in contrast to those of much of the existing literature on fiscal multipliers, which typically finds higher tax than spending multipliers. We show that this contradiction disappears once the fiscal variables used in the literature are scaled by the proper factor.
abstract_zh: 我们引入了边际累积乘数的概念——即在保持另一财政工具不变的情况下，政府支出或税收对产出的影响——并将其应用于一个涵盖1978年至2020年间16个国家财政整顿事件的知名面板数据集。在我们的基准设定中，估计两年期的边际支出乘数为1.5，而边际税收乘数接近于0。我们还通过应用McKay和Wolf（2023）的政策反事实方法估计了类似的乘数。在广泛的稳健性分析中，我们从未发现支出乘数低于1.3或税收乘数高于-1的情况。这些发现似乎与现有财政乘数文献中的多数结论相悖，后者通常发现税收乘数高于支出乘数。我们表明，一旦文献中使用的财政变量按适当因子进行缩放，这一矛盾便消失。
title: To Tax or To Ax? Marginal Tax and Spending Multipliers in Consolidations
title_zh: DP21875 征税还是削减？财政整顿中的边际税收与支出乘数

abstract: Post-pandemic inflation raised fears that U.S. monetary tightening would trigger a repeat of the 1982 sudden stop in capital flows to emerging economies. Yet as of 2026 no global recession has followed. We establish three stylized facts distinguishing the 1980s from the 2020s, beyond the shift to flexible exchange rates: monetary policy effectiveness, fiscal space, and external vulnerabilities. We rationalize them in a Mundell-Fleming framework with a fiscal space constraint, which predicts a central role for fiscal space in transmitting foreign currency risk-free rate increases. Cross-country evidence confirms that fiscal space shapes economic performance post-tightening.
abstract_zh: 疫情后的通胀引发了人们的担忧，即美国货币紧缩将重演1982年新兴经济体资本流入的突然停止。然而，截至2026年，全球并未出现衰退。我们确立了三个典型事实，用以区分1980年代与2020年代，除了转向浮动汇率制之外：货币政策有效性、财政空间和外部脆弱性。我们在一个包含财政空间约束的蒙代尔-弗莱明框架中对其进行了合理化解释，该框架预测财政空间在传导外币无风险利率上升中发挥核心作用。跨国证据证实，财政空间塑造了紧缩后的经济表现。
title: This Time Is (Mostly) Different: U.S. Tightening Cycles and Global Resilience in the 1980s vs 2020s
title_zh: 这一次（大体上）不同：1980年代与2020年代美国紧缩周期与全球韧性比较

abstract: We examine how policymakers’ speeches and monetary policy announcements at official policy meetings transmit to financial markets and the real economy in the euro area. Using high-frequency intraday data across a broad cross-section of financial assets, we introduce the Euro Area Extended Monetary Policy Event-Study Database (EA-EMPD). We refine the identification of monetary policy surprises by exploiting granular, quote-level data on individual market participants’ bid and ask quotes. This novel dataset expands the set of identifiable policy events by an order of magnitude relative to databases restricted to rate-setting meetings. Our analysis yields three main findings. First, central bank speeches move asset prices across all maturities by magnitudes comparable to those of official policy announcements. Second, the relative importance of surprises associated with policy decisions and speeches differs markedly between euro area and U.S. financial markets. Third, speech-induced short-rate shocks transmit to the real economy similarly to official policy shocks, and combining the two sources of policy shocks materially improves the precision of inference. Importantly, even under this much broader definition and measurement of monetary policy impulses, monetary policy shocks account for only a negligible share of fluctuations in real economic activity.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了政策制定者的演讲及官方政策会议上的货币政策公告如何传导至欧元区的金融市场与实体经济。利用涵盖广泛金融资产的高频日内数据，我们构建了欧元区扩展货币政策事件研究数据库（EA-EMPD）。通过利用个体市场参与者买卖报价的细粒度报价级数据，我们优化了货币政策冲击的识别方法。这一新颖数据集将可识别的政策事件集合相对于仅限于利率设定会议的数据库扩大了一个数量级。我们的分析得出三项主要发现。首先，央行演讲对各期限资产价格的影响幅度与官方政策公告相当。其次，与政策决策及演讲相关的冲击在欧元区与美国金融市场中的相对重要性存在显著差异。第三，演讲引发的短期利率冲击向实体经济的传导方式与官方政策冲击类似，且将两类政策冲击结合使用能显著提高推断的精确度。重要的是，即使在这种更为宽泛的货币政策冲击定义与测度下，货币政策冲击对实际经济活动波动的解释份额仍然微乎其微。
title: Monetary transmission with frequent policy events
title_zh: 频繁政策事件下的货币传导

abstract: In the context of escalating anthropogenic pressures on coastal ecosystems, this article employs a case study of one of China’s southeastern coastal mangrove reserves to interrogate the interplay between local communities and state authorities in natural resource governance from an ontological perspective. Through qualitative research involving 30 semi-structured interviews conducted between 2019 and 2023, we reveal how state, market, and community actors operate from fundamentally different – and often incompatible – understandings of mangroves. We trace a historical shift from a community ontology, where mangroves were perceived as socio-ecological commons buffering against flooding, to a market ontology through which mangroves were seen as barriers to marketized aquaculture development. While state intervention later curtailed market overexploitation, its regulatory, ecological ontology clashed with both the eroded community framework and the persistent market logic. Consequently, state governance, though justified by ecologically necessity, proved ontologically irreconcilable with the community’s original, relational approach. This study demonstrates that environmental governance conflicts are not merely about resource distribution but are rooted in conflicting ontologies and clashes between divergent world-making practices. It thus contributes a novel analytical lens for understanding governance conflicts in socio-ecological systems under competing state and market pressures, revealing that effective and just governance requires recognizing and navigating deep ontological divides, not just negotiating resource claims.
abstract_zh: 在沿海生态系统面临日益加剧的人为压力背景下，本文以中国东南沿海一处红树林保护区为案例，从本体论视角探讨自然资源治理中地方社区与国家权力之间的互动关系。通过2019年至2023年间开展的30次半结构化访谈的定性研究，我们揭示了国家、市场与社区行动者如何基于根本不同且往往互不相容的红树林理解方式运作。我们追溯了从社区本体论——红树林被视为抵御洪水的社会-生态共有资源——向市场本体论——红树林被视为市场化水产养殖发展的障碍——的历史转变。尽管国家干预后来遏制了市场的过度开发，但其监管性的生态本体论与已被侵蚀的社区框架及持续存在的市场逻辑均发生冲突。因此，国家治理虽以生态必要性为正当性依据，却在本体论上与社区原有的关系性路径无法调和。本研究表明，环境治理冲突不仅关乎资源分配，更根植于相互冲突的本体论及不同世界建构实践之间的碰撞。由此，本研究为理解国家与市场压力并存下社会-生态系统中的治理冲突提供了新的分析视角，揭示出有效且公正的治理不仅需要协商资源诉求，更需要识别并驾驭深层的本体论分歧。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: The ontological dimensions of coastal mangrove reserve conflicts——insights from China
title_zh: 中国沿海红树林保护区冲突的本体论维度——来自中国的启示

abstract: Many countries have adopted different price regulations to contain pharmaceutical prices, even in markets exposed to generic competition. This column documents subtle pricing patterns in the Swedish pharmaceutical market, where consumers get full reimbursement only by buying the cheapest product (the “product of the month”) and can only purchase their prescribed medicine in the packet size specified in their prescription. While the product-of-the-month regime substantially decreased prices and expenditure per pill initially, prices per pill are 4-5 times higher in package sizes sold by monopoly producers. These firms appear to have learned to exploit quirks of the regulation to increase their market power.
abstract_zh: 许多国家已采取不同的价格监管措施来控制药品价格，即便在面临仿制药竞争的市场中也是如此。本文记录了瑞典药品市场中微妙的定价模式，在该市场中，消费者只有购买最便宜的产品（“月度产品”）才能获得全额报销，并且只能按照处方中指定的包装规格购买所开具的药品。尽管“月度产品”制度初期显著降低了价格和每片药的支出，但在垄断生产商销售的包装规格中，每片药的价格高出4至5倍。这些企业似乎已学会利用监管中的特殊之处来增强其市场支配力。
title: Competition or collusion: Entry decisions in the Swedish pharmaceutical market
title_zh: 竞争还是合谋：瑞典药品市场的进入决策

abstract: Data show that trade sanctions reduce commerce between the countries imposing them and their targets. But this bilateral success can conceal a wider failure if the sanctions induce the target to build stronger trade links elsewhere. This column uses sector-level trade data, including domestic sales, to estimate both the bilateral trade destruction and the third-country trade creation effects together. Across 22 sectors, complete sanctions usually promote trade between targets and third countries. Russia’s 2006 embargo on Georgia illustrates this fact: additional trade to third markets more than offset the estimated 57% decline in exports to Russia.
abstract_zh: 数据显示，贸易制裁减少了实施国与目标国之间的商业往来。然而，这种双边层面的成功可能掩盖了更广泛的失败，如果制裁促使目标国在其他地方建立更紧密的贸易联系。本文利用包括国内销售在内的部门级贸易数据，同时估计了双边贸易破坏效应和第三国贸易创造效应。在22个部门中，全面制裁通常促进目标国与第三国之间的贸易。俄罗斯2006年对格鲁吉亚的禁运说明了这一事实：对第三市场增加的贸易量超过了向俄罗斯出口估计下降57%的影响。
authors: Gabriel Felbermayr, Ohyun Kwon, Constantinos Syropoulos, Yoto Yotov
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为贸易制裁的第三方效应，涉及俄罗斯对格鲁吉亚的禁运，未提及中国、中国企业或中国地区，与中国研究无直接关联。
title: When trade sanctions increase the target’s trade
title_zh: 当贸易制裁增加目标国的贸易
